category: Protect Model Artefacts from Unauthorized Access (PS)
subcategory_text: Protect model artefacts (weights, checkpoints, embeddings, prompts) with access controls equivalent to or stronger than those applied to source code, and protect model artefacts from theft and tampering.
implementation_examples: Store weights in an access-controlled model registry with MFA
Encrypt model artefacts at rest with HSM-backed keys
Audit weight-access events to detect extraction attempts
assessment_objectives: Determine whether model artefacts are stored with access controls.
Determine whether weight-access events are audited.
